facts.fact: 开篇第一句：约翰·格雷布尔从银行来信得知自己「死了」，随信还有水管账单与单身游广告。
facts.anchor: John Grebble first learned he was dead when he got a letter from his bank.

facts.fact: 他家地板之下藏着前房主秘密修建的核地堡；他平时把应急现金藏在里面，但很怕下去。
facts.anchor: But his was in fact very different: hidden below the basement was a secret nuclear bunker.

facts.fact: 弟弟 Geoff 屡借不还，三年前闹翻断绝来往——这通「被死亡」之后他又得回头求 Geoff。
facts.anchor: He’d continued giving Geoff loans of ever-increasing amounts, never repaid, until he ran out of patience – and guilt – and goodwill. That had been three years ago. They’d not spoken since.

facts.fact: 二十多岁时 Carolyn 在约会前一天甩了他，转投弟弟 Geoff；他从此封心不再恋爱。
facts.anchor: Twenty hours before their date, she dumped him.

facts.fact: 银行客服 Riley 坚称「死亡已核实」，随即以安全为由挂断电话。
facts.anchor: I’m sorry, Mr Grebble, the information we have that you are deceased is verified.

facts.fact: 上班公交上 Apple Pay 与借记卡全部失效，兜里只有 £50 而司机不找零，他被赶下车。
facts.anchor: You want to get on this bus, you have to pay. You have cash?

facts.fact: 拖车工以车主「已故」为由当场拖走他的电动车，他塞 £50 也没能拖住。
facts.anchor: What I mean is that this car is on a lease-purchase arrangement with someone who is now deceased. I’m repossessing it.

facts.fact: 章末：他站在大雨里，眼看拖车闪着右转灯消失——这个「死人」的一天跌到谷底。
facts.anchor: Oblivious to the now-biblical rain chucking down, he stood forlornly watching the brake lights of the truck as it approached the main road at the bottom of the hill.
